Tracklist

Glaskin are the 508th guests of our original HATE Podcast series.

Sound, Rhythm & Movement. This mix represents the music we’ve been deeply immersed in lately, featuring some of our favorite producers when it comes to driving, hypnotic grooves and peak-time intensity. Blended with plenty of our own unreleased and upcoming material, it captures the essence of our sound as it stands today.

GLASKIN is the Munich based duo of brothers Jonathan and Ferdinand, known for their exceptional and one-of-a-kind techno as well as their residency at Blitz Club.

The duo has consistently pushed boundaries with releases such as the Valve EP on their own imprint, Inertia of Motion EP on Mutual Rytm, Blue Light EP on CROWD, which earned a spot among GROOVE’s top EPs of 2025, or their standout remix of Len Faki’s Gamma on Figure.

With their live performances becoming an increasingly defining part of their artistic identity and another significant chapter of their musical journey set to unfold before the end of 2026, Glaskin show no signs of slowing down, continuing to carve out their own path in contemporary techno.

Dutch producer and DJ APHØTIC has moved fast since his first rave in 2019. He bought a mixer soon after, production followed closely behind and now he has an audience that’s streamed his music millions of times worldwide. The name comes from the aphotic zone, the stretch of ocean sunlight never reaches, and it fits the music: aggressive, dark and relentlessly quick.

In our interview, he talks about going all-in on schranz, why he’s always four tracks ahead in the booth, and the year-long project he’s finally ready to unveil spanning schranz, hard techno and hardcore. The mix is hard and fast throughout, recorded across four decks and is stacked with unreleased material of his own alongside gems from VLTN, RiVid, Lorenz B and many more. Rather than stacking banger on banger, he builds it as a story with long breaks, continuous beats and undiscovered cuts woven between the heavy hitters.
